# Extract numeric crowd values from the strings
df['crowd_numeric'] = df['crowd'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(int)

# Find the crowd for Fitzroy vs North Melbourne game
fitzroy_game = df[(df['home team'] == 'fitzroy') & (df['away team'] == 'north melbourne')]
fitzroy_crowd = fitzroy_game['crowd_numeric'].iloc[0] if not fitzroy_game.empty else None

# Find the crowd for Essendon vs Richmond game
essendon_game = df[(df['home team'] == 'essendon') & (df['away team'] == 'richmond')]
essendon_crowd = essendon_game['crowd_numeric'].iloc[0] if not essendon_game.empty else None

# Compare the two crowds
answer = fitzroy_crowd < essendon_crowd
answer
